summary: Windows mouse, keyboard, and window-control primitives exist, but no clean installed application workflow is proven.
worksToday: Builds click, type, key, focus, move, minimize, and maximize commands with dry-run support.
limitations: Coordinates and title matching are low-level and do not provide semantic application understanding.
installation: Build from source with cargo build -p elegy-desktop.
invocation: Run elegy-desktop --help and select one bounded command.

evidence.summary: The local plugin package passed structural verification.
